summary: Creates a new network connectivity endpoint that enables private connectivity between your network
description: Creates a new network connectivity endpoint that enables private connectivity between your network resources and Databricks services.  After creation, the endpoint is initially in the PENDING state. The Databricks endpoint service automatically reviews and approves the endpoint within a few minutes. Use the GET method to retrieve the latest endpoint state.  An endpoint can be used only after it reaches the APPROVED state.  :param parent: str   The parent resource name of the account under which the endpoint is created. Format:   ``accounts/{account_id}``. :param endpoint: :class:`Endpoint`  :returns: :class:`Endpoint`
